claims.claim: Redwire's Q2 2026 revenue was reported at $117.1M, up about 90% year over year, with contracted backlog of $542.1M at June 2026 and a materially improved gross-margin profile.

risks.risk: Losses and cash burn remain material; backlog is subject to contract changes and government funding.

contradictions.contradiction: Revenue/backlog and gross margin improved sharply while the company still carries sizable losses and execution risk.

unknowns.unknown: Primary-source reconciliation of Q2 cash, debt, dilution and segment economics is required by Alpha.

claims.claim: Defense Tech contribution and improved contract mix appear to be repairing execution economics, but sustained positive cash conversion is not yet established.

risks.risk: Complex fixed-price/program accounting can reverse apparent margin improvement through estimate-at-completion changes.

unknowns.unknown: This Scout artifact lacks a primary issuer filing and therefore should not satisfy packet primary-source preflight by itself.
